src_who_2020_aerobic.title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
src_who_2020_aerobic.claim: Adults should do 150-300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity per week.

src_who_2020_vigorous.title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
src_who_2020_vigorous.claim: Or 75-150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic activity per week.

src_who_2020_strength.title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
src_who_2020_strength.claim: Adults should do muscle-strengthening activities on 2 or more days a week.

src_who_2020_balance.title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
src_who_2020_balance.claim: Older adults should do varied multicomponent activity emphasising functional balance and strength on 3 or more days a week.

src_who_2020_paper.title: World Health Organization 2020 guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
src_who_2020_paper.claim: Peer-reviewed statement of the 2020 WHO guidelines.

src_ros_strong_steady_straight.title: Strong, Steady and Straight: an expert consensus statement on physical activity and exercise for osteoporosis
src_ros_strong_steady_straight.claim: Weight-bearing exercise with impact and progressive resistance training are recommended for bone strength; balance training reduces falls.

src_ros_consensus_paper.title: Strong, Steady and Straight: UK consensus statement on physical activity and exercise for osteoporosis
src_ros_consensus_paper.claim: Peer-reviewed version of the UK consensus statement.

src_bupa_genomic.title: MY Genomic Health: DNA Health Check and Medication Check
src_bupa_genomic.claim: Bupa's genomic programme reports polygenic risk scores, carrier genes and pharmacogenomics.

src_bupa_wgs.title: Whole genome sequencing programme from Bupa uncovers hidden health risks
src_bupa_wgs.claim: Bupa offers whole genome sequencing to UK customers.

src_blueprint_flex.title: Exercise and Fitness Protocol for Longevity
src_blueprint_flex.claim: Five exercise pillars: strength, cardiovascular endurance, HIIT, balance and stability, flexibility and mobility.
src_blueprint_flex.evidence_note: low — commercial protocol, not a clinical guideline

src_genomos_col1a1.title: Large-scale evidence for the effect of the COLIA1 Sp1 polymorphism on osteoporosis outcomes: the GENOMOS study
src_genomos_col1a1.claim: The COLIA1 Sp1 polymorphism (rs1800012) is associated with reduced BMD and could predispose to incident vertebral fractures in women, independent of BMD.

src_frayling_fto_2007.title: A common variant in the FTO gene is associated with body mass index and predisposes to childhood and adult obesity
src_frayling_fto_2007.claim: FTO rs9939609 is associated with body mass index.

src_kilpelainen_fto_pa_2011.title: Physical activity attenuates the influence of FTO variants on obesity risk: a meta-analysis of 218,166 adults and 19,268 children
src_kilpelainen_fto_pa_2011.claim: The association of the FTO risk allele with the odds of obesity is attenuated by 27% in physically active adults.

src_stutz_2019_evening_exercise.title: Effects of Evening Exercise on Sleep in Healthy Participants: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
src_stutz_2019_evening_exercise.claim: Overall, the studies do not support the idea that evening exercise harms sleep. However, sleep-onset latency, total sleep time and sleep efficiency might be impaired after vigorous exercise ending 1 hour or less before bedtime.
